ERC Consolidator Grant 2027: can Dylan apply?

Pierfrancesco forwarded LNL's notice of the ERC-2027-CoG call (deadline 12 Jan 2027) on 5 Nov 2026 and asked to check the time since the PhD. The rules are quoted from the binding ERC Work Programme 2027. check marks a rule not yet published; ask a fact about a person we don't have. Updated 2026-11-06.

NoCoG 2027 for Dylan
3.1 yPhD (10 Nov 2023) to the 1 Jan 2027 cut-off
> 5 – 15 yCoG 2027 window: defended 1 Jan 2012 – 31 Dec 2021
1 y 10 mhow much earlier he would have needed to defend
2029first CoG call open to him (if FP10 keeps 5–15 y; 2031 under the old 7–12 y)
~Oct 2027ERC Starting Grant 2028: his next ERC call

Dylan is not eligible for CoG 2027, and not for the 2028 CoG either. The WP 2027 accepts a PhD defended more than 5 and at most 15 years before 1 Jan 2027, i.e. between 1 Jan 2012 and 31 Dec 2021. His was 10 Nov 2023, 3.1 years before. The extensions (parental leave, illness, national service, …) only lengthen the window at its old end; nothing shortens the 5 years.

His ERC scheme is the Starting Grant. The WP 2027 StG window is “> 0 and ≤ 10 years” since the defence, so he can apply to every StG up to the 2033 call. StG 2027 closed on 14 Oct 2026; the next is StG 2028, ~mid Oct 2027, the first under FP10 (date and rules check). Pierfrancesco is right that we wait for the next call. It should be a Starting Grant, not a Consolidator.

1. The windows, call by call

Each bar is the range of PhD defence dates a call accepts. Solid: WP 2027. Dashed: later calls, assuming FP10 keeps the WP 2027 windows, and the old 7–12 y rule for comparison. Green = Dylan's date falls inside. Hover a bar for the dates.

The ERC counts the date of the successful defence of the first PhD (certificate required). If 10 Nov 2023 is UCLA's conferral date and the defence was earlier, the answer is the same: it would need to be before 1 Jan 2022.

2. The call at a glance

ERC-2027-CoG
Callopened 24 Sep 2026, deadline 12 Jan 2027
Budget€618.5 M, ~296 grants
Grantup to €2 M for 60 months (pro rata if shorter), + up to €1 M additional funding (major equipment, access to facilities, …); up to €2 M additional if the PI moves to the EU/AC from outside
Funding modelactual costs: 100 % of direct costs + 25 % flat indirect (subcontracts excluded)
PI time≥ 40 % of working time on the project, ≥ 50 % in an EU member state or associated country
Hostone legal entity in the EU/AC (INFN-LNL qualifies); team members from anywhere
ProposalB1: Part I synopsis + CV and track record; B2: Part II + resources and time commitment
EvaluationStep 1 on B1 (results 16 Jul 2027); Step 2 on B2 + interview (results 17 Dec 2027); signature ~8 Apr 2028
EligibilityPhD defended > 5 and ≤ 15 years before 1 Jan 2027, i.e. 1 Jan 2012 – 31 Dec 2021; extensions only for documented leave, illness, national service, disability, clinical training, …
Independence“A Consolidator Grant PI should have already shown evidence of research independence.”
Once per career“A researcher may be the PI of only one ERC Consolidator Grant in their career.” (being awarded one)

5. The INFN / LNL process

  • LNL Servizio Fondi Esterni (Silvia Zanella, fondiesterni.lnl@lnl.infn.it) circulated the call on 24 Sep 2026 with the WP 2027, the ERC Information for Applicants and APRE's Preparing an ERC project.
  • An INFN-hosted applicant tells the LNL Director (through the Servizio Fondi Esterni), gets approval from the Director and the President of the CSN (here CSN3), then fills the INFN Servizio Progetti manifestazione di interesse form by 4 Dec 2026. No one in our group needs it for CoG 2027.
  • The INFN national course “Bandi ERC StG e CoG 2027” (July 2026) is on the INFN Progetti SharePoint (INFN login). It covers the StG too and is worth reading in spring 2027.
  • Expect the same internal gate for StG 2028, around Aug–Sep 2027 (check).

6. What to do

  1. Reply to Pierfrancesco: not eligible for CoG 2027 or 2028. The target is the ERC Starting Grant 2028 (~mid Oct 2027) with LNL (or UNIPD) as host. Ask whether to tell the LNL Director and the Servizio Fondi Esterni now, so the support letter and the internal approval are planned. Draft in funding/ERC_COG_2027.md §7.
  2. Ask the Italian post-doc's PhD defence date. If it is 2012–2021 they could still try CoG 2027, but the INFN form is due 4 Dec 2026.
  3. Spring 2027: read the FP10 ERC work programme for 2028 (StG window, date, resubmission rules) and the INFN July 2026 course material for StG/CoG; choose the host.
  4. Get the UCLA document stating the defence date: the ERC counts the defence, not the conferral.
